recommendedTextbook.title: Christian Religious Studies for Junior Secondary Schools Book 3
recommendedTextbook.author: T. N. O. Quarcoopome
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: The Passion, Crucifixion and Resurrection of Jesus Christ
subtopics: The Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem (Palm Sunday) and Cleansing of the Temple
The Last Supper: Institution of the Holy Communion and washing of disciples' feet
Agony in the Garden of Gethsemane, trial before Pontius Pilate, crucifixion at Golgotha, and glorious resurrection on Easter Sunday
objectives: Explain the theological significance of the bread and wine during the Last Supper
Describe the legal irregularities in Jesus's trial before the Sanhedrin and Pontius Pilate
Highlight the central Christian doctrine of the bodily resurrection of Jesus Christ

topics.topic: The Promise and Descent of the Holy Spirit on the Day of Pentecost
subtopics: The Ascension of Jesus Christ and the Great Commission (Matthew 28:18-20)
The Day of Pentecost: Rushing mighty wind, tongues of fire, speaking in other tongues (Acts 2)
Peter's bold Pentecost sermon, conviction of hearers, and conversion of 3,000 souls
objectives: Enumerate the physical manifestations that accompanied the Holy Spirit's descent
Summarize the core messianic arguments in Peter's Pentecost sermon
State 4 fruits and 4 gifts of the Holy Spirit active in the Church today

topics.topic: The Early Church: Fellowship, Persecution and Expansion
subtopics: Communal fellowship in the early church: Sharing possessions, daily prayers, breaking of bread
The sin and death of Ananias and Sapphira (deceit and lying to the Holy Spirit)
Persecution: Arrest of the apostles, the martyrdom of Stephen (Acts 7), and dispersal of believers
objectives: Explain how the early church practiced genuine love, unity, and financial transparency
Analyze the tragic judgment on Ananias and Sapphira as a warning against hypocrisy
Demonstrate how Stephen's forgiving prayer during his stoning reflected the spirit of Christ

topics.topic: The Conversion and Missionary Journeys of Apostle Paul
subtopics: Saul of Tarsus as a fierce persecutor of Christians and his Damascus road encounter (Acts 9)
Baptism and ministry of Paul, partnership with Barnabas on the First Missionary Journey
The Council of Jerusalem (Acts 15): Settling the Gentile circumcision controversy
objectives: Narrate the supernatural events that led to Saul's dramatic conversion on the Damascus road
Trace the geographic route of Paul's First Missionary Journey through Cyprus and Galatia
Explain how the Jerusalem Council promoted peaceful coexistence between Jewish and Gentile believers
